paragraphs: From Finglas (Jamestown Business Park), exit the car park and turn left onto Jamestown Road.
Continue for about 200 metres and take the 1st right onto Sycamore Road.
Follow Sycamore Road for around 300 metres and turn right onto McKee Road.
Take the 1st left into Finglas Park and pull in for a short stop.
Move off from Finglas Park and bear right to stay on Finglas Park.
Turn left onto Ballygall Avenue.
After roughly 300 metres turn left onto Glasaree Road and pull in briefly.
Continue on Glasaree Road, keeping right where it bends, then turn left onto Glasanaon Road.
At the end turn right onto Griffith Road.
After about 480 metres turn left into Tolka Estate.
Practice your low-speed control around the Tolka Estate loops, following the road left, left again, then bearing right, and come to a controlled stop.
Move off again and keep left through the estate.
Turn right back onto Griffith Road.
At the end of the road turn left onto Glasanaon Road and follow it straight ahead as it becomes Clune Road.
Take the next right onto McKee Road and pull in for a short stop.
Move off and turn right into Finglas Park.
At the end of the road turn left, still on Finglas Park.
Turn left into Grove Wood.
Follow Grove Wood around to the left and carry out a U-turn when safe, watching for parked cars and pedestrians.
Move off from Grove Wood and bear right, then turn left back onto Finglas Park.
At the end of the road turn right onto McKee Road.
Take the 1st left onto Sycamore Road.
Follow it for around 300 metres and turn left onto Jamestown Road.
Turn right into Jamestown Business Park for another brief stop.
Practice the tighter estate manoeuvres by taking a series of rights through Jamestown Business Park and the Finglas Business Centre.
Take a left back onto Jamestown Business Park.
Turn right onto Jamestown Road.
Turn left onto Clune Road.
Turn left onto McKee Road.
Turn right into Finglas Park to complete the route back toward the Finglas test centre.
